summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on integration with Spark, including updates on Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features. Additionally, proposals for enhancements to the REST catalog spec and discussions on row-level ingestion challenges have emerged, reflecting ongoing efforts to improve functionality and user experience.
highlights: Proposal for generic CatalogObjectIdentifier in REST spec
Proposal for finer grained read restrictions in loadTable
